metadata.current_law: Uniform azimuthal ampere-turn density over the radial-axial winding rectangle
metadata.method: Tensor Gauss-Legendre circular loops; complete elliptic-integral vector potential
metadata.domain: Finite vacuum XYZ excluding closed winding volume
metadata.numerical_scope: Quadrature convergence must be tested; no geometric iron-field or coherent qualification

provenance.current_distribution: Coil fractions per owner; within each coil, uniform radial-axial current density and NI proportional to interval length
provenance.reference_source: Engineering initialization: 3000 A turns at 100% excitation for the independent air-core model; not a measured or OEM winding/current calibration and not inherited from Gaussian tuning. Uniform rectangular winding cross-section with mu_r=1. Turn count and individual conductor current are not specified.
provenance.source_registration_policy: Project optical registration: owner translations and assembly azimuth place the magnetic source; optical tilts rotate its source axis. Material CAD follows its separate mechanical registration; an optical tilt does not imply a mechanically tilted copper winding.
provenance.winding_material: Copper, relative permeability one; pole pieces ignored magnetically
